description:
CURRENT DISPOSITION (2026-09-07): all four still-relevant concerns are rehomed into pr-process-low-drama-acceptance: test-lock CPU protection -> pr-local-validation-singleflight; coordinator failure/restart -> pr-followup-resumable-ownership; dwell-time contract -> ci-baseline-representative-remeasure-sample and integrated acceptance; post-merge safety -> post-merge-attribution-recovery. Native queue is already active; do not execute the old Step-5 wait, steward path, or retired YAML-edit instructions below. Preserve historical blind-spot records. Existing blocked lifecycle is retained; acceptance of the replacement work is not claimed.

HISTORICAL CONTEXT (retained):
The 2026-04-30 L2 merge-loop audit produced four blind-spot findings
that all gate any future steward-queue implementation. They were
promoted to `merged-to-todo` -> this TODO on 2026-05-11, so the
blind-spot log records that they are integrated into a planned item
rather than sitting in the `actionable` re-triage queue:

  - 2026-04-30-114721-global-test-lock-cpu-protection — keep the
    global lock default until measurement shows concurrent xdist
    runs are CPU-safe.
  - 2026-04-30-114722-queue-single-point-failure — require explicit
    failure-mode analysis before adding a steward queue; prefer
    native GitHub features if they appear.
  - 2026-04-30-114723-queue-dwell-contract — treat dwell-time
    targets as part of any queue acceptance criteria; update agent
    handoff docs if dwell becomes materially longer than CI.
  - 2026-04-30-114724-post-merge-safety-tension — define the exact
    failure that develop-post-merge.yml handles; do not add a queue
    unless Step 5 metrics show a pre-merge ordering problem.

All four are blocked on the same gate:
`dev-loop-step-5-measurement-window` — a 30-day measurement window
that started 2026-04-30 and closes ~2026-05-30. Until Step 5
publishes its decision record, none of these findings are
individually actionable, which is exactly why they belong to one
handoff TODO instead of four `actionable` log entries.

This TODO does NOT pre-build the queue (that anti-pattern is
explicit in Step 5's `do_not_modify` list). It exists to ensure
that, IF Step 5 returns BUILD QUEUE, Step 6 inherits these four
findings as named acceptance criteria — not as four ad-hoc reviewer
comments that get lost in the queue spec.

If Step 5 returns DO NOT BUILD or REASSESS, this TODO closes as
superseded with a one-line note pointing to the Step 5 decision
record; the four blind-spots stay `merged-to-todo` pointing here
(this TODO's DONE record carries the outcome) — no further
status flip is needed.

anti_patterns.dont: collapse the four guardrails into a single bullet on Step 6
anti_patterns.instead: keep them as four named acceptance criteria so reviewers can trace each one back to its source.
anti_patterns.why: each one cites a specific blind-spot and a specific failure mode

anti_patterns.dont: pre-author a steward-queue implementation TODO 'just in case'
anti_patterns.why: that primes the Step 5 decision and violates the Step 5 anti-pattern list

anti_patterns.dont: re-point the blind-spots' todo_id at dev-loop-step-6-queue-decision-gate before w2 has actually folded the guardrails into it
anti_patterns.instead: leave todo_id on this TODO until the queue spec demonstrably owns them.
anti_patterns.why: Step 6 may resolve as DO NOT BUILD and never carry them

preserves.behavior: All four blind-spots' historical record — the only mutations are the `status`/`todo_id` frontmatter line and append-only triage-log entries; the `## Finding` / `## Why this matters` body text is immutable.
Superseded pending work and legacy notes are historical only; the named replacement items own the current outcome.
The 'do not pre-build the queue during measurement' anti-pattern in Step 5.
dev-loop-step-5-measurement-window's calendar-gated Blocked status — this TODO must not push Step 5 to publish early.

verifications.description: Step 5 decision record exists before this TODO begins w2
If BUILD QUEUE: Step 6 YAML lists the four guardrails by blind-spot ID
verifications.expected: four matching lines, one per blind-spot id

verifications.command: for id in 2026-04-30-114721-global-test-lock-cpu-protection 2026-04-30-114722-queue-single-point-failure 2026-04-30-114723-queue-dwell-contract 2026-04-30-114724-post-merge-safety-tension; do uv run --project _project/scripts -- python _project/scripts/sweep_blind_spots.py show $id | grep -E 'status:|todo_id:'; done
verifications.description: Four blind-spots show status: merged-to-todo with todo_id populated
verifications.expected: all four show status: merged-to-todo and a non-null todo_id

work_units.notes:
Trigger: `dev-loop-step-5-measurement-window` publishes
`_project/decisions/dev-loop-measurement-<window-end>.md` with a
BUILD QUEUE / DO NOT BUILD / REASSESS verdict.
  - BUILD QUEUE -> proceed to w2.
  - DO NOT BUILD -> close this TODO as completed-via-supersede
    with a one-line note citing the Step 5 decision SHA. The
    four blind-spots stay `merged-to-todo` -> this TODO; the
    DONE record is their disposition. (Optionally append a
    one-line triage entry to each pointing at the decision SHA.)
  - REASSESS -> stay Blocked; let Step 5's REASSESS path drive
    the next iteration.
